notes.title: New Patch 0.0.5
notes.notes:
Heyo!

Thanks again for all the fantastic feedback!

Here's a new lil' patch for y'all.

Change log 0.0.5:
- Bosses are more aggressive. Less just floating about.
- Reduced Mana Crystal Increase upgrade to +5mp (down from +10mp)
- Fixed issue where health on players and enemies didn't fill all the way up.
- Improved cast bar readability and juice
- Character Tooltips in warband
- Multi-Heal circle is back
- Results screen now shows gained currencies
- Raised limit of leaderboard entries to 9999
- New logo and title screen
- Updated leaderboard screen

/Hannes & Alfred

notes.title: Bugfix Patch 0.0.4
notes.notes:
Hey fam!

Absolutely blown away by the feedback so far. 
Thank you so much. You are awesome!

To celebrate, here's a new build with a couple of fixes to issues you reported.

Changelog:
	✔ Quick Heal now triggers instantly on the second click, but costs 3X the mana.
	✔ Team is now perfectly centered on screen.
	✔ Enemies and bosses no longer spawn super close to the team.
	✔ Multi heal cast time now matches tooltip.
	✔ Multi heal can no longer be cast without targets.
	✔ Pickups no longer slide off screen.
	✔ Fix issue where Heal was getting stuck when target died JUST before the cast landed. Potentially a _frame perfect_ bug :).
	✔ Fix issue where you could click through the tab bar onto the upgrades.
	✔ Enabled HiDPI support - should solve issues on 4k monitors.

Known issues:
	- Latest(ish) nvidia drivers cause garbled graphics on some systems. Nothing I can do right now, but keeping track of it.

/Hannes
